R197: The modeled usable capacity is 80% for LFP (20-100%), 85% for sodium ions (15-100%), and 50% for lead-acid (50-100%). In this model, LFP and sodium ions require fewer exchanges than lead-acid over 20 years. Standard LFP voltages limit sodium ions to about 85% of rated capacity; the shallower discharge favors a longer cycle life. Lead-acid is limited to the upper half and loses useful capacity under intense discharge. The drops in observed weather from {startYear} to {endYear} show when grid or generator power would be needed.
